evidence.statement: Uploaded NCBI annotation packages correspond exactly to the frozen LIFE-CODE genome sequences: ECOLI 1/1, PYRO 1/1, YEAST 17/17 complete FASTA records match by normalized sequence SHA-256.
Because every frozen sequence record has an exact full-record match in its annotation package, the frozen occurrence coordinates can be transferred by record identity without coordinate lift-over.
